The '''Water Keeper''' was the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] responsible for monitoring and maintained the water supply in the city of [[Kala'uun/Legends|Kala'uun]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. The Water Keeper and his extended family maintained pumps and water conduits that ensured water was supplied from the cistern to the clan wells. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the position of Water Keeper was held by [[Troa'shak]].
